---
title: "About"
---

This site is a place for notes related to using **Python for chi-square
(Chi2) analyses**.

The goal is to keep a growing set of small, focused examples that show
how to set up categorical data, run a chi-square test, and interpret the
results. Where possible, the examples use fictional datasets that are
generated in the notebooks themselves, so anyone can reproduce the
results without downloading extra files.

The site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and the code for
each page is written in Python.
